आईजीए (IgA) स्रावी संस्करण टेम्पलेट

Neonatal gut immune defenses maternal milk ke immunological components par rely karte hain.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because saponified lipid soap chemistry manufacturing ka byproduct hota hai.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because Novolac syrup synthetic polymer resin suspension hai.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because protein hydrolysates laboratory cell culture media supplements hote hain.

qe: Which specific category of immune cells drives the 'cell-mediated immunity' (CMI) response, responsible for graft rejections in tissue transplantations?
qh: प्रतिरक्षा कोशिकाओं की कौन सी विशिष्ट श्रेणी 'सेल-मध्यस्थता प्रतिरक्षा' (cell-mediated immunity) प्रतिक्रिया को संचालित करती है, जो ऊतक प्रत्यारोपण में ग्राफ्ट अस्वीकृति के लिए जिम्मेदार है?
oe: B-lymphocytes manufacturing immunoglobulins
T-lymphocytes / T-cells
Non-nucleated blood platelet cells
Linear unbranched polysaccharide builders
oh: इम्युनोग्लोबुलिन का निर्माण करने वाले बी-लिम्फोसाइट्स
टी-लिम्फोसाइट्स / टी-कोशिकाएं (T-lymphocytes / T-cells)

रैखिक अशाखित पॉलीसेकेराइड निर्माता

• Option 2 is Correct because T-lymphocytes (specifically Cytotoxic T-cells) cell-mediated immunity coordinate karte hain; yeh transplanted tissue ke foreign MHC/HLA antigens ko self vs non-self differentiate karke identify karte hain aur graft rejection trigger karte hain.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because platelets blood clotting aur coagulation cascade mein participate karte hain, adaptive cellular rejection mein nahi.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because polysaccharide chains structural carbohydrate molecules hain, immune cells nahi.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because economic wealth standard of living ko affect kar sakti hai par direct biological health status ke equivalent nahi hoti.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because temporary emotional expressions clinical overall health status evaluate nahi karte.

PCR sequence amplification

Typhoid fever ke clinical diagnosis ke liye patient ke serum mein specific bacterial agglutinins detect kiye jaate hain.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because ELISA primarily AIDS, viral infections aur antigen-antibody screening ke liye widely use hota hai.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because Erythrocyte Sedimentation Rate (ESR) non-specific general inflammation marker hai.

• Option 3 is Correct because 'Widal Test' typhoid fever (enteric fever) ka classic serological agglutination test hai, jisme patient ke serum antibodies Salmonella typhi ke somatic 'O' aur flagellar 'H' antigens ke sath react karke clumping (agglutination) show karte hain.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR) molecular sequence amplification technique hai.

oe: Influenza and Smallpox
Rheumatoid arthritis and vascular tumors
Cancer and common Allergy matrices

एलर्जी और स्थानीयकृत कैंसर ट्रैक
e:
Diseases transmission pattern ke basis par do broad categories mein classified hoti hain: Communicable (infectious) aur Non-communicable (non-infectious).

• Option 1 is Correct because Influenza (caused by Myxovirus influenzae) aur Smallpox (caused by Variola virus) dono highly contagious infectious diseases hain jo respiratory droplets aur contact se person-to-person spread hoti hain.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because rheumatoid arthritis autoimmune disorder hai aur vascular tumors benign/malignant non-communicable growths hain.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because cancer non-communicable cellular deregulation hai aur allergy immune hypersensitivity hai.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because allergy aur cancer dono non-infectious conditions hain.

Within the mature red blood cells of the host

e:

• Option 2 is Incorrect because human liver cells mein asexual pre-erythrocytic schizogony hoti hai.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because mosquito salivary glands mature sporozoites ke temporary storage aur transmission reservoir ka kaam karti hain.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because human red blood cells mein erythrocytic asexual schizogony aur gametocyte formation hota hai.

qh: जब Plasmodium परजीवी मानव लाल रक्त कोशिकाओं को तोड़ते हैं, तो रक्तप्रवाह में कौन सा विषाक्त पदार्थ जारी होता है, जिससे कंपकंपी के साथ बार-बार बुखार आता है?
oe: Haemozoin
Serotonin alignment fluid
Histamine inflammatory ester
Tannic acid chemical derivative
oh: हीमोजोइन (Haemozoin)
सेरोटोनिन संरेखण द्रव
हिस्टामाइन भड़काऊ एस्टर
टैनिन एसिड रासायनिक व्युत्पन्न
e:
Malaria paroxysm (cyclic high fever with shivering chills) specific toxic metabolites ke intravascular release se trigger hota hai.

• Option 1 is Correct because erythrocytic schizogony ke dauraan parasite host hemoglobin ke globin part ko consume karta hai aur toxic free heme ko insoluble crystalline pigment 'Haemozoin' mein convert karta hai; infected RBCs ke synchronous rupture hone par haemozoin bloodstream mein aakar cyclic pyrogenic shivering chills cause karta hai.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because serotonin platelet granules aur mast cells se release hone wala vasoconstrictor amine hai.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because histamine mast cells dwara allergic responses mein release hota hai.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because tannic acid plant-derived polyphenol astringent compound hai.

qe: Which specific viral vector represents the primary operational driver that transmits Dengue fever and Chikungunya into human hosts?
qh: डेंगू बुखार (Dengue fever) और चिकनगुनिया को मानव मेजबान में प्रसारित करने वाला प्राथमिक कीट वाहक कौन सा है?
oe: Aedes mosquitoes
Common house flies
Female Anopheles mosquitoes
Cockroach structural vectors
oh: एडीज मच्छर (Aedes mosquitoes)
सामान्य घरेलू मक्खियाँ (Musca domestica)
मादा एनोफिलीस मच्छर
तिलचट्टा संरचनात्मक वाहक
e:
Arboviral epidemics human populations mein specific daytime-biting mosquito vectors ke proliferation se correlate hoti hain.

• Option 1 is Correct because Dengue virus (Flavivirus) aur Chikungunya virus (Togavirus) dono infected female 'Aedes mosquitoes' (primarily Aedes aegypti aur Aedes albopictus) ke human biting se transmit hote hain.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because houseflies mechanical vectors hain jo amoebiasis aur typhoid jaise enteric pathogens spread karti hain.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because female Anopheles mosquito protozoan malaria parasite ki specific vector hoti hai.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because cockroaches mechanical pest carriers hain jo arboviruses transmit nahi karte.

qe: Which precise group of clinical symptoms serves as a landmark diagnostic indicator confirming an infection of human pneumonia?
qh: लक्षणों का कौन सा समूह मानव निमोनिया (pneumonia) के संक्रमण की पुष्टि करने वाला प्रमुख नैदानिक संकेतक है?
oe: High fever, stomach ulcers, and absolute loss of appetite
Chronic constipation, abdominal pain, and structural cramps
Difficulty in respiration accompanied by fever, chills, and cough
Nasal congestion, continuous watery discharge, and mild sore throat
oh: तेज बुखार, पेट के अल्सर और भूख की पूर्ण हानि
पुरानी कब्ज, पेट में दर्द और संरचनात्मक ऐंठन
सांस लेने में कठिनाई के साथ बुखार, ठंड लगना और खांसी (Difficulty in respiration, fever, chills, and cough)
नाक में संकुलन, लगातार पानी जैसा स्राव और हल्का गले में दर्द
e:
Bacterial lower respiratory tract infection alveolar exudation aur gas exchange impairment create karta hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because sustained fever aur stomach intestinal ulceration typhoid infection ka hallmark profile hai.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because constipation aur abdominal cramps amoebiasis ya intestinal helminthiasis ke symptoms hain.

• Option 3 is Correct because pneumonia (Streptococcus pneumoniae ya Haemophilus influenzae) ke classic clinical symptoms hain: high fever, intense chills, productive cough aur alveolar fluid consolidation ki wajah se severe dyspnea (difficulty in respiration).

• Option 4 is Incorrect because nasal congestion aur watery discharge common cold (Rhinovirus) ke upper respiratory symptoms hain.

qe: What formal term defines the internal cellular genes that natively exist in an inactive state but can transform into cancer-causing oncogenes upon mutation?
qh: उन आंतरिक कोशिकीय जीनों (cellular genes) को क्या कहा जाता है जो सामान्यतः निष्क्रिय अवस्था में रहते हैं लेकिन उत्परिवर्तन होने पर कैंसर का कारण बन सकते हैं?
oe: Regulatory operon nodes
Proto-oncogenes / Cellular oncogenes
Structural alignment sequences
Expressor sequence segments
oh: नियामक ओपेरॉन नोड्स
प्रोटो-ऑन्कोजीन / कोशिकीय ऑन्कोजीन (Proto-oncogenes / Cellular oncogenes)
संरचनात्मक संरेखण अनुक्रम
एक्सप्रेशर अनुक्रम खंड
e:
Normal cell division aur differentiation carefully regulated proto-oncogenes dwara control hoti hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because regulatory operon nodes bacterial transcription units ke parts hain.

• Option 2 is Correct because normal healthy cells ke genome mein present dormant regulatory genes ko 'Cellular oncogenes' (c-onc) ya 'Proto-oncogenes' kehte hain; jab mutagens ya carcinogens ke impact se inme gain-of-function mutations hoti hain, toh yeh hyperactive oncogenes mein transform hokar uncontrolled oncogenesis start kar dete hain.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because alignment sequences bioinformatics ka tool hai, specific neoplastic human genes nahi.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because expressor segments eukaryotic oncology ka formal nomenclature nahi hai.

qe: What descriptive terminology defines the dangerous lifecycle stage where malignant tumor cells detach, migrate via blood streams, and establish secondary tumors across distant organs?
qh: घातक ट्यूमर कोशिकाओं (malignant tumor cells) के रक्तप्रवाह के माध्यम से शरीर के दूरस्थ अंगों में फैलने और नए ट्यूमर बनाने की प्रक्रिया को क्या कहा जाता है?
oe: Metagenesis alternation
Teratogenesis toxicity
Mitotic index scaling
Metastasis
oh: मेटाजेनेसिस (Metagenesis) पीढ़ियों का एकांतरण
टेराटोजेनेसिस (Teratogenesis) विषाक्तता
माइटोटिक इंडेक्स स्केलिंग
मेटास्टेसिस (Metastasis)
e:
Malignant neoplasms local growth aur distant vascular dissemination ke through systemic destruction produce karte hain.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because Metagenesis cnidarians (jaise Obelia) mein asexual polyp aur sexual medusa generations ka alternation of generation hota hai.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because Teratogenesis developing embryo mein structural birth defects induce karne ki process hai.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because mitotic index tissue mein actively dividing cells ka simple quantitative ratio hai.

• Option 4 is Correct because 'Metastasis' malignant tumors ki sabse feared aur dangerous property hai jisme cancerous cells primary tumor site se detach hokar blood ya lymph circulation ke through travel karti hain aur distant healthy organs mein settle hokar secondary tumors establish karti hain.

qe: When an individual displays persistent behavioral and social maladjustments despite lacking physical symptoms, what classification describes their clinical health state?
qh: जब कोई व्यक्ति शारीरिक लक्षणों की कमी के बावजूद लगातार व्यवहारिक और सामाजिक रूप से तालमेल नहीं बिठा पाता है, तो मनोचिकित्सक के अनुसार उनका स्वास्थ्य कैसा है?
oe: The individual is diagnosed as mentally or socially unhealthy due to psychological discomfort
The profile marks an absolute lack of athletic training metrics
The individual is locked in an economically unprosperous state
The individual requires immediate free-radical polyolefin updates
oh: मनोवैज्ञानिक परेशानी के कारण व्यक्ति को मानसिक या सामाजिक रूप से अस्वस्थ माना जाता है
प्रोफ़ाइल एथलेटिक प्रशिक्षण मेट्रिक्स की पूर्ण कमी को चिह्नित करती है
व्यक्ति आर्थिक रूप से असमृद्ध स्थिति में बंद है
व्यक्ति को तत्काल मुक्त-कण पॉलीओलेफिन अपडेट की आवश्यकता है
e:
Holistic medicine health ko bio-psycho-social spectrum par measure karti hai jahan mental aur emotional stability equally mandatory hain.

• Option 1 is Correct because agar kisi individual mein physical pathological lesions nahi bhi hain, par agar severe emotional distress, behavioural aberrations aur social maladjustments present hain, toh WHO aur psychiatric norms ke according person 'Mentally aur Socially Unhealthy' classify hota hai.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because athletic training sports capability hai, baseline clinical mental health requirement nahi.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because economic income level direct clinical psychological diagnosis define nahi karta.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because polyolefins synthetic chemical plastics hote hain.

qe: Which specific underlying cellular event characterizes the onset of an autoimmune disease like rheumatoid arthritis?
qh: रुमेटॉइड आर्थराइटिस (rheumatoid arthritis) जैसे ऑटो-इम्यून रोग की शुरुआत किस विशिष्ट कोशिकीय घटना के कारण होती है?
oe: The complete cross-linking of structural alpha-helix channels
The absolute deactivation of all circulating lymphocytes
The immune system loses its ability to differentiate foreign molecules from self-cells, attacking the body's own tissues
The sudden over-production of non-specific volatile amides
oh: संरचनात्मक अल्फा-हेलिक्स चैनलों का पूर्ण क्रॉस-लिंकिंग
सभी परिसंचारी लिम्फोसाइटों का पूर्ण निष्क्रियकरण
प्रतिरक्षा प्रणाली विदेशी अणुओं को स्वयं की कोशिकाओं से अलग करने की क्षमता खो देती है, जिससे शरीर के अपने ऊतकों पर हमला होता है
गैर-विशिष्ट वाष्पशील एमाइड्स का अचानक अत्यधिक उत्पादन
e:
Immune system ka fundamental feature 'self-tolerance' hota hai jisse yeh host molecules aur foreign antigens ko accurately distinguish karta hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because protein cross-linking synthetic materials ka feature hai.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because autoimmunity mein lymphocytes hyperactive aur autoreactive hote hain, de-activated nahi.

• Option 3 is Correct because Autoimmune diseases (jaise Rheumatoid Arthritis) mein immunological self-tolerance breakdown ho jati hai; immune system self antigens aur foreign pathogens mein differentiate nahi kar pata aur body ke own synovial membranes/tissues par autoantibodies dwara chronic destructive attack launch kar deta hai.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because volatile amides chemical organic derivatives hain, autoimmune pathology ka mechanism nahi.

qe: Which social and physical interaction is completely safe and does not serve as a mode of transmission for the Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV)?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा सामाजिक या शारीरिक संपर्क ह्यूमन इम्युनोडेफिशिएंसी वायरस (HIV) के संचरण का माध्यम नहीं है?
oe: Sharing contaminated needles among intravenous users
Unprotected sexual contact with a diagnosed individual
Transfusion of contaminated blood plasma batches
Shaking hands or standard casual contact with an infected individual
oh: अंतःशिरा (intravenous) उपयोगकर्ताओं के बीच दूषित सुइयों को साझा करना
निदान किए गए व्यक्ति के साथ असुरक्षित यौन संपर्क
दूषित रक्त प्लाज्मा बैचों का आधान (Transfusion)
संक्रमित व्यक्ति से हाथ मिलाना या सामान्य आकस्मिक शारीरिक संपर्क
e:
HIV infection strictly body fluids ke exchange se transmit hota hai aur ordinary social interactions se spread nahi hota.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because IV drug users mein shared infected needles directly virus ko blood stream mein inoculate karti hain.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because unprotected sexual intercourse globally HIV spread ka most common transmission route hai.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because infected blood transfusion HIV transmission ka extremely high-risk route hai.

• Option 4 is Correct because HIV air, water, sweat, tears ya casual physical contact (jaise shaking hands, hugging, sharing food, toilets) se bilkul transmit nahi hota kyunki virus intact skin penetrate nahi kar sakta aur body fluids ka direct internal exchange nahi hota.

qe: What is the biochemical identity and microbial origin of the addictive narcotic drug commonly known as 'smack'?
qh: आमतौर पर 'स्मैक' (smack) के रूप में जानी जाने वाली मादक दवा की जैव रासायनिक पहचान और उसका पादप स्रोत क्या है?
oe: Tropane alkaloids harvested from the young flowers of Datura pinata
Cannabinoid structures extracted from the green leaves of Cannabis sativa
Diacetylmorphine obtained by acetylation of morphine extracted from the latex of Papaver somniferum
Cocaine base refined from the Young fruits of Erythroxylum coca
oh: धतूरा पिनाटा के युवा फूलों से काटा गया ट्रोपेन एल्कलॉइड
कैनबिस सैटिवा की हरी पत्तियों से निकाले गए कैनाबिनोइड संरचनाएं
पापावर सोमनिफेरम (Papaver somniferum) के लेटेक्स से निकाले गए मॉर्फिन के एसिटिलेशन द्वारा प्राप्त डायएसिटाइलमॉर्फिन
एरिथ्रोक्साइलम कोका के युवा फलों से परिष्कृत कोकीन बेस
e:
Opioid narcotics central nervous system aur gastrointestinal tract ke specific opioid receptors se bind hokar depressant action show karte hain.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because Datura hallucinogenic tropane alkaloids contain karta hai.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because Cannabis sativa se cannabinoids (charas, ganja, bhang, marijuana) harvest hote hain.

• Option 3 is Correct because street drug 'Smack' (Heroin) chemically 'Diacetylmorphine' hoti hai (a white, odorless, bitter crystalline compound), jo opium poppy plant (Papaver somniferum) ke unripened capsule latex se extract kiye gaye morphine ke chemical acetylation (−COCH 
3
​
  addition) se synthesize hoti hai.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because Erythroxylum coca cocaine alkaloid ka natural plant source hai.

qe: Which specialized cytokine protein group is naturally synthesized and secreted by virus-infected cells to shield neighboring uninfected cells from further viral replication?
qh: वायरस से संक्रमित कोशिकाओं द्वारा कौन सा विशिष्ट साइटोकाइन प्रोटीन समूह प्राकृतिक रूप से स्रावित होता है जो स्वस्थ कोशिकाओं को संक्रमण से बचाता है?
oe: Histamine inflammatory ester
Serotonin tracking fluid
Interferons
Colostrum immune factor
oh: हिस्टामाइन भड़काऊ एस्टर
सेरोटोनिन ट्रैकिंग द्रव
इंटरफेरॉन (Interferons)
कोलोस्ट्रम प्रतिरक्षा कारक
e:
Innate immune defense cytokine signaling molecules use karke viral propagation block karta hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because histamine mast cells dwara allergic vasodilation ke liye release hota hai.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because serotonin neurotransmitter aur vasoactive amine hai.

• Option 3 is Correct because jab koi host cell virus se infect hoti hai, toh woh specialized signaling glycoproteins release karti hai jinhe 'Interferons' (IFNs) kehte hain; yeh surrounding uninfected cells par bind hokar translation-inhibitory proteins (TIP) synthesize karwate hain jo further viral replication ko prevent karte hain.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because colostrum postpartum mother milk fluid hai jo secretory IgA deliver karta hai.

qe: What primary category of acquired immune response is directly responsible for the rejection of foreign tissue grafts and transplanted organs?
qh: ऊतक प्रत्यारोपण (tissue transplantations) में विदेशी ग्राफ्ट और प्रत्यारोपित अंगों की अस्वीकृति के लिए मुख्य रूप से कौन सी प्रतिरक्षा प्रतिक्रिया जिम्मेदार होती है?
oe: Humoral antibody-mediated immunity
Cell-mediated immune response driven by T-lymphocytes
Physiological barrier exclusion profiles
Auto-immune baseline shock
oh: हास्य एंटीबॉडी-मध्यस्थता प्रतिरक्षा (Humoral immunity)
टी-लिम्फोसाइट्स द्वारा संचालित सेल-मध्यस्थता प्रतिरक्षा प्रतिक्रिया (Cell-mediated immune response)
शारीरिक बाधा बहिष्करण प्रोफाइल
ऑटो-इम्यून बेसलाइन शॉक
e:
Organ transplantation mein histocompatibility matching ke baad bhi post-operative immunosuppression mandatory hota hai taaki immunological rejection prevent ho sake.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because Humoral immunity B-cells ke circulating antibodies dwara extracellular pathogens neutralise karti hai.

• Option 2 is Correct because T-lymphocytes dwara mediated 'Cell-Mediated Immune Response' (CMI) non-self HLA/MHC complexes ko scan karti hai aur Cytotoxic T-cells graft cells par cytotoxic attack launch karke foreign organ transplant ko reject kar dete hain.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because physiological barriers (stomach acid, tears) innate first-line defenses hain.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because auto-immune disease self-tissues ke loss of tolerance par based hoti hai, foreign graft rejection par nahi.

qe: Which predominant class of immunoglobulins is packed heavily inside a mother's colostrum to supply passive immunity to her newborn infant?
qh: नवजात शिशु को निष्क्रिय प्रतिरक्षा (passive immunity) प्रदान करने के लिए माँ के कोलोस्ट्रम (colostrum) में कौन सा इम्युनोग्लोबुलिन वर्ग प्रचुर मात्रा में होता है?
oe: IgD surface indicator
IgE hypersensitivity factor
IgG serum configuration
IgA type
oh: आईजीडी (IgD) सतह संकेतक
आईजीई (IgE) अतिसंवेदनशीलता कारक
आईजीजी (IgG) सीरम विन्यास
आईजीए प्रकार / IgA (Secretory IgA type)
e:
Newborn infants ka immature adaptive immune system maternal antibodies ke passive transfer par rely karta hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because IgD B-lymphocytes ki membrane par antigen receptor ke roop mein express hota hai.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because IgE allergic hypersensitivity aur helminth parasite infections mein participate karta hai.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because IgG primarily placenta cross karke fetal circulation mein intrauterine passive immunity deta hai.

• Option 4 is Correct because parturition ke baad initial days mein mammary glands se secrete hone wale nutrient-dense yellowish fluid 'Colostrum' mein dimerized Secretory 'IgA' antibodies heavy concentration mein hote hain, jo newborn ke digestive mucosa ko mucosal pathogen invasion se protect karte hain.

qe: Which alkaloid component present in tobacco blends triggers the immediate release of adrenaline and noradrenaline, expanding heart rate and blood pressure parameters?
qh: तंबाकू के मिश्रण में मौजूद कौन सा अल्कलॉइड घटक एड्रेनालाईन और नोरएड्रेनालाईन के स्राव को उत्तेजित करता है, जिससे हृदय गति और रक्तचाप बढ़ जाता है?
oe: Curcumin chemical derivative
Tannic acid matrix
Nicotine
Catechin antioxidant fraction
oh: करक्यूमिन रासायनिक व्युत्पन्न
टैनिक एसिड मैट्रिक्स
निकोटिन (Nicotine)
कैटेचिन एंटीऑक्सीडेंट अंश
e:
Tobacco consumption autonomic sympathetic stimulation ke through severe cardiovascular stress generate karta hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because curcumin turmeric (Curcuma longa) ka active anti-inflammatory component hai.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because tannic acid tea leaves aur bark mein present mild astringent polyphenol hai.

• Option 3 is Correct because tobacco smoke aur chewing tobacco mein potent psychoactive alkaloid 'Nicotine' hota hai; Nicotine adrenal gland ke medulla ko stimulate karta hai jisse adrenaline aur noradrenaline circulation mein dump hote hain, resulting in accelerated heart rate aur increased blood pressure.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because catechins green tea ke polyphenolic antioxidants hain.

qe: What biochemical component is explicitly packed inside clinical antivenom formulations deployed to neutralize lethal snake venom inside an endangered patient?
qh: सांप के जहर को बेअसर करने के लिए नैदानिक एंटीवेनम (antivenom) फॉर्मूलेशन के भीतर कौन सा जैव रासायनिक घटक विशेष रूप से पैक किया जाता है?
oe: Active proteolytic clearing enzymes
Attenuated snake antigens
Antigen-antibody combined complexes
Pre-formed antibodies specific to the venom toxins
oh: सक्रिय प्रोटीयोलाइटिक समाशोधन एंजाइम
दुर्बल सांप के एंटीजन
एंटीजन-एंटीबॉडी संयुक्त कॉम्प्लेक्स
जहर के विषाक्त पदार्थों के लिए विशिष्ट पूर्व-निर्मित एंटीबॉडी (Pre-formed antibodies)
e:
Life-threatening emergencies mein host ke immune response wait karne ka time nahi hota, isliye artificial passive immunization provide ki jaati hai.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because proteolytic enzymes foreign proteins ko non-specifically degrade karenge par venom specific neutralization provide nahi karte.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because attenuated antigens active vaccination mein use hote hain jo slow antibody production induce karte hain, snakebite emergency mein venom instant kill kar dega.

• Option 3 is Incorrect because neutral complex formulation therapeutic protection provide nahi karta.

• Option 4 is Correct because Antivenom (jaise polyvalent snake antivenom) horses ya sheep ko hyperimmunize karke harvest kiye gaye 'Pre-formed, standardized antibodies' (immunoglobulins) hote hain jo circulate hokar injected lethal venom toxins ko immediately neutralize karte hain.

qe: Which human biological gland is characteristically large and highly active at birth but undergoes systematic reduction and atrophy with advanced aging?
qh: कौन सी मानव ग्रंथि जन्म के समय बड़े आकार की और अत्यधिक सक्रिय होती है, लेकिन बढ़ती उम्र के साथ व्यवस्थित रूप से आकार में छोटी (atrophy) हो जाती है?
oe: Thymus gland
Thyroid metabolic framework

e:

An active free-radical addition polymer initiator
A volatile aliphatic open-chain non-polar gas matrix
Nucleoside

Amide linkage systematically identical to a biological peptide bond

3'-5' phosphodiester linkage

They run parallel in the exact same 5' to 3' spatial direction
They are arranged as separate open-chain unlinked carbohydrate blocks

वे अलग-अलग खुली श्रृंखला वाले असंबद्ध कार्बोहाइड्रेट ब्लॉक के रूप में व्यवस्थित होते हैं

• Option 1 is Incorrect because nucleic acids natural biopolymers hain jo non-covalent hydrogen bonding se paired rehte hain.

• Option 2 is Incorrect because dono strands parallel polarity mein nahi chal sakte kyunki unke base pairs hydrogen bonding ke liye geometrically fit nahi honge.

Strong phosphodiester covalent bridges
Hydrogen bonds established between complementary purines and pyrimidines

ग्लोबुलर प्रोटीन के समान सहसंयोजक पेप्टाइड लिंकेज

• Option 2 is Incorrect because phosphodiester bonds intra-strand backbone banate hain, inter-strand base pairing nahi.

• Option 3 is Correct because opposing strands ke complementary bases (Adenine-Thymine aur Guanine-Cytosine) ke beech specific 'Hydrogen bonds' form hote hain jo double helix ko stably hold karte hain.

• Option 4 is Incorrect because peptide linkages amino acids ke beech protein polypeptide synthesis mein bante hain.
